title: Cottage II at West End/Vandy/Hillsboro
description:
Enjoy this renovated, historic, 1925  bungalow, private cottage apartment, right in the heart of Nashville, TN.  Enjoy bustling midtown and walk to coffee shops, trendy shopping, restaurants and Centennial Park.  Within minutes of Vandy, Belmont, Hillsboro Village,  and downtown.

The space
This is a large historic home that has 3 private residences. This is the main entrance unit with and upstairs bedroom and bath. All entrances are private.

Guest access
Park FREE directly in front of your front door.  This is a walkable and safe community with quick Uber/Lyft rides to most anywhere in the city. There are also multiple restaurants, coffee shops and shopping within walking distance.

Other things to note
This is one of three, private apartments located in a huge, historic home. There are no shared spaces.  There are washer and dryer units located in the basement for all to use.
